evaluation.limitation: Historical summary consistency only; not a new holdout evaluation, signature, or independent verification of the reported predictions.

development.limitation: Development diagnostics include ambiguous/conflicting examples excluded from fitting; these results are not held-out accuracy.

limitations: This audit cannot approve a release or attest real-application accuracy.
Controlled data stays controlled. Repeated templates and renamed families do not establish independent evidence.
New candidate tests require a preregistered untouched holdout; do not retune against published failed tests.

reproduction.limitation: Reproduction on this installed runtime only; not independent accuracy or cross-platform determinism.

parity.limitation: Numeric artifact integrity/parity only. This check does not consume test data, approve categories, or promote the active model.
